description: Split-flap departure-board text for SwiftUI and UIKit: every letter rolls, flips or flickers into place, played by Core Animation
rules: Add the package https://github.com/enavermate/SplitflapKit with Swift Package Manager and import SplitflapKit; the view is UIKit-based and runs on iOS and iPadOS 15+ and on the Mac through Mac Catalyst; native macOS (AppKit) is not supported
In SwiftUI use Splitflap(text) with the splitflap… modifiers; in UIKit use SplitflapView and set text to animate
The flip transition needs the colour under the text: .flip(surface: .black); reel and roll take a direction
cellWidth is .natural (reel and roll only) or .uniform; without it flip and scramble keep each letter near its own width
Durations are in seconds (duration 0.65, stagger 0.04), not milliseconds
